summary: Above Food Ingredients filed a Form 6-K (press release) updating the status and timing of its annual report on Form 20-F for fiscal year ended January 31, 2025. The delay is partly due to circumstances arising from certain subsidiaries being placed into receivership. The audit remains ongoing with no assurance on timing or results. This is a routine SEC filing status update and does not represent a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special situation category.
